name: Soldering Tip Temperature Thermometer, 0–800 °C
tagline: Soldering tip thermometer, 0 °C to 800 °C, 3½ digits, °C and °F, with max hold.
description: The Vartech 191 AD is a thermometer for checking the temperature of a soldering iron tip. It reads from 0 °C to 800 °C on a 3½-digit display in °C or °F and has a max-hold function. An external sensor socket takes the supplied bead-type probe for measurements away from the instrument.

name: Multifunction Soldering Tester
tagline: Soldering tester that measures tip temperature, leakage voltage and ground resistance.
description: The Vartech 192 checks the three things that matter on a soldering iron: tip temperature, leakage voltage and ground resistance. Temperature resolution is 1 °C or 1 °F. Use it to confirm that a station is holding its temperature and that the tip is safely grounded for ESD-sensitive work.
